evidence.quote: we show, for the first time, that it is possible for such agents to outperform human crowdworkers on the MiniWob++ benchmark of GUI-based instruction following tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张(摘要)

evidence.quote: We show, for the first time, that an agent using pixel-only inputs and a generic action space can outperform human crowdworkers on the MiniWob++ benchmark, significantly improving over prior work on this setting
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张原文,范围为 MiniWob++ benchmark

evidence.quote: its performance drops by 75% when the DOM information is removed from the agent’s observations
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap:CC-Net 去 DOM 后掉 75%(引用他文,非本文实测)

evidence.quote: they are not always available
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap:结构化输入并非总能获得

evidence.quote: Importantly, the DOM information is not provided by the environment and is therefore not used in any way to define observations or actions.
evidence.support_explanation: 信息可见性:仅像素,无 DOM

evidence.quote: Our action space consists of raw mouse and keyboard actions
evidence.support_explanation: 通用低层动作空间

evidence.quote: In preliminary experiments, we did not observe significant gains from conditioning on past observations for MiniWob++, and thus we only use the screenshot of the current step in our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: MiniWoB++ 仅用当前帧,无历史压缩

evidence.quote: we track which actions have been taken for a given observation, and select the highest probability action in the beam that has not previously been taken given the current observation
evidence.support_explanation: 防环回退规则(唯一的错误恢复机制)

evidence.quote: we apply tree search as a simple method for policy improvement
evidence.support_explanation: 策略改进=MCTS,非 REINFORCE/PPO

evidence.quote: tree search leverages the deterministic nature of the environment to look ahead at the consequences of possible actions
evidence.support_explanation: 搜索依赖确定性、可重置环境(特权)

evidence.quote: The model is trained on transitions from the human demonstrations, which demonstrate close to optimal behavior in many cases.
evidence.support_explanation: 价值网络用人类演示训练且后续保持固定

evidence.quote: We performed 2 iterations of policy improvement with tree search, collecting a total of 826K episodes across all tasks, and tuning for a further 26K steps.
evidence.support_explanation: 2 轮 MCTS 蒸馏,826K 条 episode

evidence.quote: We then filter trajectories where the raw reward is
evidence.support_explanation: 选择规则:按环境原始奖励阈值过滤(阈值 <0.8 被剔除)

evidence.quote: To produce these trajectories, we randomly sample MiniWob++ tasks and seeds, and select actions according to
evidence.support_explanation: 训练 episode 来自随机采样的任务与种子

evidence.quote: Iteration Policy 0 1 2 Greedy 66.5 93.1 96.2 Tree Search 91.7 98.4 —
evidence.support_explanation: 同一模型 greedy vs 搜索及迭代结果

evidence.quote: The best greedy policy achieves performance close to the best tree search policy, but does not require access to reward signals or additional exploration at inference time.
evidence.support_explanation: 部署时无需搜索/奖励

evidence.quote: relied on the ability to procedurally generate new MiniWob++ environment and instruction variations and receive reward signals for task completion
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认的适用前提

evidence.quote: we did not perform a detailed comparison relative to other search and RL algorithms in this study
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认未与其他 RL/搜索算法对比

evidence.quote: In the behavioral cloning setting, pre-training improves task scores from 17.1 to 66.5 on MiniWob++ and from 1.1 to 46.7 on WebShop.
evidence.support_explanation: 预训练消融(BC)
Ours=96.2, Ours(BC)=66.5, Human=94.3, CC-Net=96.3, CC-Net(BC)=38.7(59 任务均值)

evidence.quote: we estimate the performance of CC-Net without DOM information by assuming that the drop in performance on the subset of tasks we study was also 75%
evidence.support_explanation: 去 DOM 的 CC-Net 基线为估算值

evidence.quote: Pix2Act achieves comparable performance to their best model, while relying on only a subset of the information used by CC-Net, and using a comparable number of human demonstrations for training.
evidence.support_explanation: 与带 DOM 的 CC-Net 持平

evidence.quote: Another difference is that CC-Net uses a real time setting, which enables some forms of interaction not supported by our environment
evidence.support_explanation: 与 CC-Net 环境不同(实时 vs Selenium)

evidence.quote: WebGUM outperforms Pix2Act when compared on this setting.
evidence.support_explanation: WebShop 上仍落后 HTML 输入方法

evidence.quote: Pretraining leads to non-trivial generalization (28.3) to held out tasks that were unobserved at training time compared to a randomly initialized model (7.6).
evidence.support_explanation: 9 个留出任务(BC)

evidence.quote: We manually pick the 9 tasks to verify they include only actions or elements that would be reasonable to generalize to from the training tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 留出任务由人工挑选

evidence.quote: Note that determining the set of 59 tasks was based solely on the feasibility of conversion to our observation and action format, and not based on model performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 59 任务按可转换性选定

evidence.quote: Therefore, for simplicity, we excluded tasks that involve scrolling: book-flight
evidence.support_explanation: 排除滚动、复制粘贴、动画等任务

evidence.quote: For each task, we compute the mean over 100 random seeds, and then compute the mean over 59 MiniWob++ tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 评测分母:59 任务×100 seeds

evidence.quote: we ran 3 trials with different evaluation seeds for the strongest Pix2Act model
evidence.support_explanation: 3 次不同评测种子(仅最强模型)

evidence.quote: the standard deviation across these trials was 0.15
evidence.support_explanation: 评测方差 0.15

evidence.quote: This results in different renderings of the same underlying environment state, introducing a shift between the screenshots seen during training and those observed at test time.
evidence.support_explanation: 演示与环境渲染分布不一致(作者承认)

evidence.quote: We fine-tuned models using 64 Google Cloud TPU v3 cores.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练算力

evidence.quote: variant with 282M parameters
evidence.support_explanation: 模型 282M

evidence.quote: Task Score, which is the average reward across 500 test instructions
evidence.support_explanation: WebShop 标准 500 测试指令

evidence.quote: results in a drop of 4.0 in Task Score
evidence.support_explanation: WebShop 先在 MiniWoB++ 中间微调的迁移收益

evidence.quote: we have trained and evaluated models only in offline environments
evidence.support_explanation: 仅离线模拟环境,无真实服务

evidence.support_explanation: ~1.3M 演示 (81% 可转换)
